description: Create a structured garden planting schedule from unstructured notes. Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/planting_schedule.xlsx. Read the planting notes from ~/Documents/Garden/planting_notes.txt. Organize the information into a table starting at row 3 with columns: Crop, Days from Frost, Planting Date (with formula), Spacing (inches), Companions. Include at least 6 crops. Use formulas in column C that reference the frost date in C1 to calculate planting dates. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
